name: co.marketmayhem/mcp
description: Launch and trade BSC tokens on Market Mayhem. Your own wallet signs; dry run by default; spend caps.

environmentVariables.name: MM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's own wallet key. Signs locally; never sent anywhere. Unset: read-only.

environmentVariables.name: MM_LIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let the agent send transactions. Unset: dry run.

environmentVariables.name: MM_MAX_PER_TX
environmentVariables.description: Most one transaction may spend, per currency, e.g. BNB:0.05

environmentVariables.name: MM_MAX_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Most per UTC day, per currency, e.g. BNB:0.25

environmentVariables.name: MM_ALLOW_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated token addresses the agent may trade. Unset: any.

environmentVariables.name: MM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Market Mayhem API key: higher limits, and you become the default referrer.
